Skip to the board

WHTBRDR

Draw with a mouse, a stylus or a finger. The arrow keys slide the board; Ctrl plus and Ctrl minus zoom; Ctrl 0 fits the page. Hold Space and drag to slide it with the mouse.

    Left and Right go to the page before or after; with Shift they pick the pages on the way. Alt with Left or Right moves the picked pages. Delete removes them. Enter goes back to the board. Tab goes on to the page's buttons: move, present, open, duplicate, copy, cut, paste, delete. Control C, X and V copy, cut and paste the picked pages.
